purpose: Research-only candidate data for Höglandsleden. Do not auto-import; normalize manually after per-section research review.

overview.routeType: multi-section hiking trail with loop, branches, and inter-trail connectors
headlineDistanceNotes: Smålandsleden overview says the trail can be walked as a ca 300 km loop.
The official stage pages for HÖ1-HÖ23 total 428.6 km, which supports municipal descriptions of 44 mil/440 km when branches/connectors are included.
Use per-stage official distances for normalization; do not import a single headline distance without topology context.
overview.mainLoopInterpretation: HÖ2 plus HÖ4-HÖ17 form a closed loop from Skuruhatt via Valbacken, Lilla Bjälkerum, Ädelfors, Högarp, Lemnhult, Lindshammar, Ramkvilla, Asa, Hultsjö, Sävsjö, Forsa, Vikskvarn, Lövhult, Ränneborg, and back to Skuruhatt.
overview.branchAndConnectorInterpretation: HÖ1 links Västra Lägern to Skuruhatt; HÖ3 links Valbacken to Mariannelund; HÖ18-HÖ23 run west from Vikskvarn via Tomtabacken, Hok, Byarum, Skillingaryd, and Åsafors to Kärringabacka/Järnbärarleden.

counties.name: Jönköpings län
counties.evidence: Most official Naturkartan stage pages use Jönköpings län; HÖ1-HÖ10 and HÖ12-HÖ23 are under the Jönköpings län source path checked in the initial scrape.

counties.name: Kronobergs län
counties.evidence: Official overview says the trail reaches Kronobergs län in the south; Naturkartan search result for HÖ11 Asa-Hultsjö is under Kronobergs län.

municipalityEvidenceNotes: Sävsjö kommun's older overview names the five Högland municipalities Aneby, Eksjö, Nässjö, Sävsjö, and Vetlanda.
Current Smålandsleden overview also mentions Eksjö/Nässjö in the north, Vetlanda/Sävsjö, Kronobergs län in the south, Kalmar county border in the east, and Hestra in the west.
Gnosjö tourism says about 17 km pass through Gnosjö and overlap Järnbärarleden; HÖ23 connects at Kärringabacka.
Växjö/Asa and the exact Kronoberg municipal extent need section-level verification.

topologyCaveats: Smålandsleden overview says 'three etapper' connect to other systems/counties, but the current HÖ18-HÖ23 west branch consists of six official stage pages. Treat this as ambiguous wording until the section synthesis confirms intended route-group modeling.
Older Eksjö municipal wording divides Höglandsleden into four parts/delleder, which does not directly match the current HÖ1-HÖ23 official stage numbering.

marking: Sävsjö municipality says Höglandsleden is marked with orange paint and blue square signs with two hikers.
Smålandsleden explains that marking varies because older markings remain and a new standard from 2024 is being introduced gradually.
Anslutningsleder are marked with orange markings with a dashed outer line.
campingAndShelters: Municipal and official stage pages repeatedly mention wind shelters, raststugor, camping, and bookable accommodation on some stages.
Use section-level verification before importing shelters or camping; some are bookable/commercial and should not be modeled like public shelters.
fire: Smålandsleden general rule is to use prepared fireplaces and check current fire bans.
Stage pages identify several grillplatser/eldplatser; import only after coordinate verification.
water: Smålandsleden general planning page says there are often water sources but hikers should carry water if unsure.

Official stage text mentions drinking water at specific places including Asa herrgård, Hultsjö/Hjärtlanda churchyards, Djurgårdsstugan, Fällhemmet, Svartåns källa, and others; verify each per section before import.
dogsLivestockHuntingSeasonal: Several official stage descriptions mention grazing animals/betesdjur. Record gates, leash/livestock caution, and reserve-specific dog rules during section research.
No whole-trail hunting closure was found in phase 1; field-report and local-rule research remains required.
protectedNature: Smålandsleden states protected-area rules may override allemansrätten.

Official stage descriptions mention protected areas including Skuruhatt/Skurugata, Klinten, Högarps kulturreservat, Helvetes håla, Stora och Lilla Fly, Vikskvarn, Bäckafall, Hackareviken, Gärahovs ängar, and others. Verify exact reserve boundaries and regulations section by section.

officialMapSources.notes: All HÖ1-HÖ23 official stages returned GPX in phase-1 scrape. HÖ11 also appears under Kronobergs län in Naturkartan search, but the Jönköpings-län GPX URL returned usable data during the scrape.

mapsAndGeometry.geometryReadiness: planning-grade to navigation-grade pending section QA
geometryNotes: Per-stage GPX endpoints align closely at adjacent stage boundaries in the initial scrape.
No official single whole-trail GPX/KML/GeoJSON was found in phase 1.

OSM has older partial Höglandsleden route relations with old delsträcka/etapp naming and 2018-era municipal source URLs; treat OSM relation data as stale or supplementary until checked section by section.

osmFindings.notes: Relations found use older names such as Delsträcka 3 Klinten-Ingatorp and Vetlanda Etapp 1-5; current official HÖ numbering is more authoritative.

sourceContradictions.details: Smålandsleden overview says ca 300 km as a loop; municipalities/tourism say 44 mil/440 km; official HÖ1-HÖ23 stage pages total 428.6 km. Working interpretation: ca 300 km refers to the main loop, 44 mil refers to all branches/connectors.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: High. Route groups must distinguish main loop from connectors/branches rather than assigning a single linear order only.

sourceContradictions.details: Overview says three stages connect other systems/counties, but current stage list suggests HÖ1 and HÖ3 are single connector stages while the west branch HÖ18-HÖ23 contains six stages.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Medium. Confirm intended branch grouping before route-builder presets.

sourceContradictions.details: The URL slug is ho18-tomtabacken-vikskvarn, but title/text and GPX direction are Vikskvarn to Tomtabacken.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Medium. Use official title and GPX direction, not the slug, for section direction.

sourceContradictions.details: Stage info says 24.1 km while description text says 23.7 km. GPX computes to 24.077 km.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Low. Use 24.1 km from the official info panel.

sourceContradictions.details: Older sources describe del two/four and older section names/distances that do not match current HÖ stage numbering exactly.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Medium. Prefer current Smålandsleden/Naturkartan HÖ stage pages.

staleSourceRisks: OSM Höglandsleden relations reference older PDFs and older naming; use only as supplemental geometry/context.
Municipal overview pages may lag behind the 2026 Smålandsleden/Naturkartan platform and current HÖ stage numbering.
Smålandsleden marking standard has changed since 2024 and is being introduced gradually, so field signage may vary.
Naturkartan pages expose public-transport widgets but not always static stop data; commute endpoints need independent verification.
openQuestions: Exactly which municipalities and counties each stage traverses, especially HÖ10-HÖ11 around Asa/Kronoberg and HÖ23 around Kärringabacka/Gnosjö.
Whether official route groups should be modeled as main loop plus three connectors, main loop plus east/north/west branches, or another route-builder topology.
Which official nearby facilities have exact coordinates and should be imported versus treated as access metadata, side trips, commercial services, or pending records.
Whether any current closures, reroutes, forestry works, hunting-season advisories, water reliability warnings, or protected-area restrictions affect individual stages.

phase1ResearchLog.summary: Read existing repo research/source examples and docs; created isolated candidate directory; inventoried official Smålandsleden HÖ1-HÖ23 pages; downloaded/parsing-tested all per-stage Naturkartan GPX URLs; checked municipal overview sources and Smålandsleden general rules pages; checked Overpass for OSM relations.
phase1ResearchLog.result: Phase 1 overview complete enough to start per-section six-agent research batches.
